breadcrumbs.name: New Construction Homes for Sale in West Vancouver

faq_heading: New construction in West Vancouver: your questions answered

faq.q: What counts as new construction on this page?
faq.a: Active MLS® listings in West Vancouver where the board's age field is 0 or less: homes finished this year and homes listed before completion, in houses, townhomes and condos.

faq.q: Where are the newest homes in West Vancouver?
faq.a: Over the past year the newest sold homes were houses in Altamont: median build year 2008, 5 sales, median price $5,950,000.

faq.q: How fast do newer homes sell in West Vancouver?
faq.a: The quickest group among the newer ones was condos in Dundarave: 22 days to sell at a median, closing at 96.2% of the list price.

blocks.text: What newer homes in West Vancouver have sold for
In November 2025 to October 2026, houses in Altamont had the newest stock of any West Vancouver sub-area with enough sales to measure: median build year 2008, 5 sales, median price $5,950,000.

None of the 24 sub-area and home-type groups with 5 or more sales had a median build year of 2020 or later, so most of what sold was older stock; newer homes here are mostly first sales that never reach the resale shelf.

items.t: Park Royal condos: 20 sold at a median of $1,027,500 (middle half between $872,500 and $1,477,500), taking 74 days at 95.2% of the list price, with a median build year of 2007.
